title: Sprite-order pin checks 2 of 3 order copies — the committed sprites.json order array is never compared to files[]
evidence:
tools/test_sprite_order.py:20-21:
GEN = ROOT / "tools" / "gen_sprites.py"
ODIN = ROOT / "app" / "render" / "sprites.odin"
tools/test_sprite_order.py:45-47:
    so = script_order()
    of = odin_files()
    if so == of:
app/render/sprites.odin:55,63:
	for f, i in files {
		sh.textures[i] = tex
app/render/sprites.odin:100,119:
	order, oko := obj["order"].(json.Array)
			sh.bboxes[i][k] = f32(n)
assets/sprites/sprites.json:3-14:
 "order": [
  "house_0", ... "campus"
 ]
detail: textures[i] binds by sprites.odin files[]; bboxes[i] binds by sprites.json's own order array. A consistent SPRITE_ORDER+files[] reorder without a Blender re-render (CI has none) passes gate 7 yet mis-crops positionally — the B1 class recurs.
recommended_fix: Extend test_sprite_order.py to also parse assets/sprites/sprites.json order and assert it equals files[].

title: build_puck indexes PUCK_TIER directly — the old .get(ports, 1.0) default and 4-16 clamp were removed
evidence:
diff.patch:789 removed:
-    scale = {4: 1.0, 8: 1.15, 16: 1.30}.get(ports, 1.0)
diff.patch:804 added:
+    r = PUCK_R * PUCK_TIER[ports]
gen_sprites.py:65 (inside the SILHOUETTE SPEC fill-in-the-blanks block):
PUCK_TIER      = {4: 1.0, 8: 1.15, 16: 1.30}   # tier size ladder (keep)
gen_sprites.py:345 (main, OUTSIDE the SPEC block):
    for ports in (4, 8, 16):
detail: PUCK_TIER sits in the user-editable SPEC surface; the ports tuple does not. A tier-key edit raises an unguarded KeyError mid-render, after earlier PNGs are already overwritten. No validation of ports.
recommended_fix: Use PUCK_TIER.get(ports) and raise a loud named error listing valid tiers, or assert ports in PUCK_TIER at build_puck entry.

title: Zero-alpha render emits a negative bbox into sprites.json and exits 0 — no generator-side guard
evidence:
gen_sprites.py:322,332-333:
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = w, h, -1, -1
    top_y = h - (miny + (maxy - miny + 1))  # bottom-up -> top-down flip
    return [minx, top_y, maxx - minx + 1, maxy - miny + 1]
gen_sprites.py:354,356-357:
        boxes[n] = content_bbox(os.path.join(OUT, n + ".png"))
    print("sprites.json written — %d sprites" % len(SPRITE_ORDER))
detail: If a sprite renders with no alpha content, minx/miny stay w/h and maxx/maxy stay -1: a [256,256,-256,-256] bbox is written and the run reports success. Only the pre-existing renderer-side range check catches it, failing the whole sheet.
recommended_fix: After each content_bbox call, assert 0 < w, 0 < h, and x+w <= 256, y+h <= 256; abort the run on violation.
